title: Geoeconomic Monitor: Russian Hopes, Chinese Fears
text:
Geoeconomic Monitor: Russian Hopes, Chinese Fears

Tom Holland, Tom Miller, Udith Sikand

Gavekal Research | 16 Oct 2026

The US president has high hopes that his putative deal with Vladimir Putin to resume Russia’s exports of diesel will bring down global—and US—prices. But, as Tom Holland explains, the targeted export volumes are too small, the outlook for shipments too uncertain, and the disruptions in the underlying global market for crude oil too great to restore “normality” to global diesel prices into 2027. In addition, Tom Miller examines the US government’s attempt to forge a trade bloc to counter Chinese industrial overcapacity, and Udith Sikand looks at the impact of Washington’s latest restrictions on the H-1B visa program used to employ Indian tech workers in the US.In this issue:
